title: Understanding Regularization
text: Regularization is a technique used to prevent overfitting in models. It adds a penalty to the loss function to discourage complex models. Can you think about how this might affect the parameters of the model?

title: Role of Lambda in Ridge Regression
text: In ridge regression, the regularization parameter lambda controls the strength of the penalty applied to the model's coefficients. Consider how changing lambda might influence the model's complexity and the coefficients' values.

title: Is Lambda Fixed?
text: Think about whether lambda is a parameter that is set before the model is trained or if it is something that is determined by the data itself.
